scope.result: The exact stored-integer formula is falsified at 822830 comparable cells; the annual physical scale and generating lineage remain unqualified.

selection_chronology.fixed_selection_rule: Reuse the six original format diagnostics and both separately frozen January raw-zero/nodata controls; no outcome-driven replacement or additional search.
selection_chronology.attempt_1: Failed before comparison because the independent parser supported classic little-endian TIFF but refused annual little-endian BigTIFF.
selection_chronology.attempt_2: Preserved all twelve monthly results, then refused bio12 because stored SCALE and OFFSET declarations were absent.
selection_chronology.packing_hypotheses_timing: Frozen after monthly values had been inspected and before annual pixels or annual-sum comparisons were read.

packing_hypotheses.evidence: GDAL reader identity defaults; a conditional interpretation, not reported metadata.
Earlier retained CHELSA technical specification section7.1 bio12 lists scale0.1/offset0; applicability to the exact current body is unverified.

selection_chronology.whole_grid_formula_timing: Chosen post hoc after the exact-floor relation matched all six usable fixed-cell conditional comparisons.
selection_chronology.worst_cell_timing: Selected from the completed whole-grid result as the first maximum-absolute-residual cell; the second decoding is a selected diagnostic, not independent discovery.

whole_grid.integer_arithmetic: Sum twelve UInt16 monthly raw arrays into UInt32; compare annual UInt32 to integer floor division by10. Compute residual10*annual-sum as signedInt64. No floating-point threshold.
whole_grid.validity: A cell is comparable only if raw!=65535 and native mask!=0 in every monthly file and annual. Count every excluded cell and report the per-asset valid counts. No substitution for invalids.
whole_grid.selection: All base blocks in January raster block-row/block-column order; clip edge blocks to true dimensions. No overview substitution.

selection.rule: The first cell attaining the maximum absolute raw residual in the frozen block/cell scan order; selected by the completed whole-grid diagnostic, not an independent discovery case.

selected_worst_cell_independent_check.independent_decoder_scope: Rasterio/GDAL and Pillow-bundled LibTIFF independently decoded this selected cell in all 13 assets; the separate decoder did not verify the full grid.

whole_grid.scope: All base-grid cells decoded through Rasterio/GDAL only.

selected_cells.scope: Both readers agreed for 91 in-bounds raw values in the fixed audit and for all 13 raw values at the selected worst cell.

provenance.new_public_artifact_sha256: Recorded externally in the companion note because a file cannot contain its own SHA-256 without changing it.

limitations: Annual SCALE/OFFSET are absent; GDAL 1/0 values are unqualified reader defaults.
The monthly explicit binary64 scale 0.1 and rational raw division by 10 are distinct arithmetic statements.
No annual generating algorithm, producer lineage, physical scale, or climate accuracy is verified.
Native masks include land and ocean; there is no land/coast qualification or area weighting.
Per-block failure fractions are storage diagnostics without demonstrated biological interpretation.
No genetic predictive gain, source admission, model eligibility, or publication eligibility is established.
